quests.sentenceWithBlank: Please review the attached draft ____ send me your feedback by Friday.
quests.completedSentence: Please review the attached draft and send me your feedback by Friday.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'And' links these two related requests in the email. 'But' would incorrectly suggest some conflict between reviewing the draft and sending feedback.
quests.nativeTip: Both requests are simply part of the same email ask, without any surprise or condition between them.
quests.example: Please review the attached draft and send me your feedback by Friday.

quests.sentenceWithBlank: I tried calling the client twice this morning, ____ neither call went through.
quests.completedSentence: I tried calling the client twice this morning, but neither call went through.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'But' captures the disappointing outcome of both attempts. 'So' would reverse the logic, making the failed calls a result of trying twice.
quests.nativeTip: Neither call connecting is an unexpected letdown, not simply an added fact.
quests.example: I tried calling the client twice this morning, but neither call went through.

quests.sentenceWithBlank: I'm reaching out ____ I haven't received the signed contract yet.

quests.ruleExplanation: 'Because' gives the direct reason for the email. 'So' would reverse the logic, making the outreach the cause of the missing contract.
quests.nativeTip: This explains the reason for reaching out, not a contrast or an added fact.
quests.example: I'm reaching out because I haven't received the signed contract yet.

quests.sentenceWithBlank: ____ Tuesday doesn't work for everyone, we can push the kickoff to Wednesday instead.
quests.completedSentence: if Tuesday doesn't work for everyone, we can push the kickoff to Wednesday instead.

quests.nativeTip: This describes a possible scheduling conflict, not something certain.
quests.example: if Tuesday doesn't work for everyone, we can push the kickoff to Wednesday instead.

quests.example: once everyone has confirmed their availability, I'll send out the calendar invite.

quests.completedSentence: The vendor missed two consecutive shipments, so we had to push the launch date back a week.

quests.sentenceWithBlank: We're front-loading the testing phase this sprint ____ any major issues can surface before the release freeze.

quests.visualAnchor: 🌉 Clause A ──[ so that ]── Clause B

quests.sentenceWithBlank: Please finalize your section of the deck ____ tomorrow's client review.
